title: Filing: Wise plans to debut on the Nasdaq as WSE, and relist in London for its secondary listing; Wise reports year-to-March net revenue up 19% YoY to $2.5B (Aisha S Gani/Bloomberg)
summary: Aisha S Gani / Bloomberg: Filing: Wise plans to debut on the Nasdaq as WSE, and relist in London for its secondary listing; Wise reports year-to-March net revenue up 19% YoY to $2.5B — Wise Group Plc is making its trading debut in the US with a Nasdaq listing as the financial technology firm tries to take advantage …
